parameters.content:
## Connect · Scheduler
Every day at 10:00 (Helsinki) this decides, per bundle, whether today is the day to contact the owner. It only reads bundles and adds reminder rows to decisions: first messages still go through **Step 3**, reminders through **Reply**, button presses through the **router**. No existing workflow was changed.

## Start
**Daily 10:00** = real run.
**Run manually** = dry run (plans, sends nothing).
**Webhook** POST /webhook/connect-scheduler with { as_of, dry_run, bundle_ids } to demo any date.

## Load
Config: as_of (now, or from the webhook), dry_run, bundle_ids. Then every QUEUED and SENT bundle, all bundle dates, and the contact log in decisions (REMIND_1 and STAFF_FLAGGED rows).

## Decide: the rules
**deadline** = next holiday − slowest main channel − 1 day (Tripadvisor 3 d → 4 d; Foursquare and AI assistants ~7 d are best effort)
**first message** from deadline − 14 d · **STAFF** at once, once
**one reminder** 4 d after sending, at the latest deadline − 2 d · no reply needed after a button press

## Dry run
Returns the plan (who would get what, and why) and sends nothing.

## First message
All due bundle IDs go to the Step 3 webhook in one call. Step 3 keeps its own rules (opt-out, STAFF, AUTO_APPLY, SUGGEST / ASK) and sets SENT.

## One reminder
Same text and same 3 buttons as the first message, with a "reply by" line in the owner language. A REMIND_1 row is logged even if sending fails, so nobody is reminded twice.
